integrity: The recent primary source was inspected at its endpoint theorem, analytic continuation, pole-plus-moment representation, and branch-cut density. The density asymptotic was reconstructed using standard complete-elliptic expansions independently checked against NIST DLMF Sections 19.12 and 19.5. The moment asymptotic was proved by an explicit Laplace-scale dominated-convergence argument; finite coefficient calculations are only secondary sanity checks.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the endpoint quotient coefficient sequence a_n and its third derivative only; no asymptotic is claimed for the reciprocal sequence b_n. Only the leading regularly varying equivalent is asserted. The complete 2022 publisher article was not available through the inspected full-text route, leaving a limited residual originality risk for an older differently worded coefficient asymptotic.
title: Sharp logarithmic decay at the elliptic absolute-monotonicity endpoint
